dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as a single, thin, high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts against a darker grey-brown ground color.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, well-defined white longitudinal boundaries visible on the outer edges of the folded secondary and primary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast, roughly triangular white patch is visible on the posterior neck, situated between the black crown and grey mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear boundary exists between the black crown and the white nape patch, with a distinct transition from white to grey-olive at the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white margins are visible on the outer rectrices (tail feathers), creating a high-contrast lateral border to the tail silhouette.
